verdict.rationale: Cactus officially runs natively on macOS on Arm and installs via Homebrew, so Apple Silicon is supported on the CPU path. The docs say it needs no GPU, and a community tester reports Needle 3 does not run inference on the Apple GPU at all, using the GPU only for training. The Metal half of the story is therefore unmet. Missing for 10: Metal/GPU-accelerated inference, documented ARM-specific optimizations (e.g., NEON kernels), and Apple Silicon performance benchmarks.
